features.text: Performance
Professional Dual Fuel

Introducing LG's first Dual Fuel range. It gives you the benefit of a gas cooktop and an electric oven all in one. This range uses gas to fuel the cooktop for faster heating and boiling, and electricity to power the oven for professional-style baking results.
ProBake Convection® Delivers Perfection on every rack

LG ProBake Convection® delivers even baking results on every rack, every time*. Inspired by pro-style ranges, this new LG range moved the heating element from the bottom of the oven to the back wall for optimal heat distribution. Enjoy consistent browning on top and bottom- with every cookie baked to perfection.
Infrared Heating
LG’s Infrared Heating cuts over 20% of your cooking time¹—with no preheating required.
UltraHeat™ Burner
The LG UltraHeat™ 18,500 BTU burner, delivers every bit of the precision you love about gas with even more power. No more waiting around to bring water and other liquids to boil.
Design
Large 7.3 cu.ft. Capacity

With 7.3 cubic feet of capacity, you can cook more in less time with LG SIGNATURE Oven. The capacity of the top part is 3.0 cu.ft. and the bottom part is 4.3 cu.ft. Save your time and energy with mega capacity.
Sleek Textured finish
The Textured finished delivers an elevated look, with subtle detailing that enhance your kitchen.
Scratch-Resistant Finish, Irresistible Design
Full stainless-steel body with scratch-resistant textured finish makes for an impeccable exterior design, enhancing its minimalist style to the fullest.
Metal touch Controls
Metal touch controls not only look sleek but allow you to operate your range with just a touch of your finger. Best of all they have been designed with practicality in mind.
Convenience
A smarter home starts with the LG ThinQ®

Use the ThinQ® app to remotely start/stop the oven, set timers, and check on your appliance from anywhere. Simply speak to control your appliance with Alexa or Google Assistant. Plus, with scan-to-cook technology and LG Smart Cooking Partners, you can send cooking instructions straight to your oven by simply scanning the barcode on the package of ready-made meals, or by selecting one of the thousands of recipes in the app.
ThinQ care helps keep your appliance running smoothly
Discover ThinQ Care in the ThinQ® app and get proactive usage, maintenance and diagnostic alerts on your smartphone to help keep your LG smart appliances running smoothly.
A clean oven in just 10 minutes with EasyClean®

LG EasyClean® brings you the fastest oven-cleaning feature yet. In three steps and 10 quick minutes your oven can be clean, without strong chemical fumes or high heat.⁵ Simply spray the interior with water, press EasyClean® and in 10 minutes, quickly wipe away any leftover grime. Also use the self-clean cycle for a deep clean.
